layman_headline: Market is surging but everything looks overheated — patience is the play right now.
layman_explanation: Bitcoin just hit $80,000 for the first time since May, and the entire crypto market has rallied hard over the past week. Our XRP position is down about 3% from entry but is still well within its trading range and above its stop-loss. Every swing candidate on the watchlist has either already run up 50-75% in a week (way too extended to chase) or is a stablecoin with no upside. This is not the time to buy — it's the time to hold what we have and wait for a pullback.
layman_action: Hold the current XRP position. Don't chase any of these extended rallies. Wait for prices to cool off or for a clear pullback entry before adding new positions.
expert_reasoning: The entire market is in a broad-based rally with BTC +25.5%, ETH +31.9%, SOL +34.7%, and XRP +52.4% on the week. Fear & Greed at 74 (Greed) and rising confirms momentum but warns of overheated conditions. All swing candidates with actual price action (MON, LIT, PUMP, XRP) have RSIs at or above 60-86, signaling overbought conditions across the board. BTC dominance at 59.3% is historically high, suggesting alt season hasn't fully rotated yet. Our XRP position at -3.2% unrealized is well above its $1.30 stop-loss with a $1.85 exit target still intact. No new position meets our risk/reward criteria — entering anything after 30-75% weekly moves violates swing trading discipline.
risk_factors: BTC at $80K is a major psychological resistance level — a rejection here could drag the entire market down 10-15% quickly
XRP's 52% weekly move creates elevated correction risk; a pullback to $1.30-1.40 range is plausible
Fear & Greed trending toward extreme greed historically precedes sharp corrections
watch_list: BTC price action around $80K — whether it consolidates or faces rejection will determine alt performance
XRP holding above $1.40 support level as the weekly rally cools
SOL after Solana vote on burning mechanism — could create a tradeable pullback entry around $90-95
market_context: The crypto market is experiencing a powerful recovery rally with BTC hitting $80K for the first time since May. Fear & Greed at 74 and rising signals growing optimism but also elevated reversal risk — this is late-stage momentum, not an entry point.
context_banner: Broad crypto rally has pushed all major assets into overbought territory — discipline means waiting for the pullback, not chasing the move.

key_signals.description: Fear & Greed at 74 (Greed) and trending higher from 66.3 weekly average — market is getting overheated, historically a warning sign for near-term pullbacks.
PUMP RSI at 86 and MON RSI at 62 confirm overbought conditions across swing candidates — no safe technical entries exist.
Korean bank tapping Ripple for payments provides fundamental support for existing XRP position, justifying continued hold.
Bitcoin hitting $80K for first time since May confirms broad market strength, but 'analysts say next pullback will be key' aligns with our cautious stance.
XRP volume at $6.1B is extremely elevated, confirming strong interest but also suggesting the bulk of the move may already be priced in.
